data.name: Romance on the Bay
data.headline: 3-Hour Private Sail • Engagements • Proposals
data.description:
##About
Celebrate your lives together on this private sailing experience. Set sail with just the two of you or include your friends, family & guests to join you. 

##Duration 
3 Hours - Set sail on a 3-hour Day Sail or Sunset Sail. Our departure times are adjusted to seasonal sunset patterns.

##Rates
**Private Charter: 1–6 People** - *$595* (Comes with Captain)

**Bareboat Charter: 7-12 People** - *$595 - $1,000* (Captain not Included)

**Bareboat Charter Info:** Following current Coast Guard regulations, your Bareboat Charter doesn't include a Captain. But don't worry, we have a list of skilled Licensed Captains familiar with our program and boats. Captains on our roster charge $50 an hour (or $75 for bank holidays), plus tips, payable directly to them after the trip.

##More Info
- All beer, seltzers, non-alcoholic drinks and snacks are complimentary. We don’t give you just one and have you pay for more! 🥂
data.cancellation_notes:
**Cancellation Policy**
We understand things happen and plans change, that's why we have the most flexible cancellation policy in the industry. Reservations are 100% refundable if canceled outside of 72 hours of the date of the departure. 

**Weather Policy**
Sail San Diego does not operate in unsafe weather conditions, but a light rain shower is not a deterrent. The Captain will assess the weather and should the Captain determine that the conditions are unsafe to run the charter, the charter may be rescheduled or it will be canceled.

- If a trip is canceled by Sail San Diego for any reason, you will have the option of receiving store credit for a future trip or receiving a full refund.
data.booking_notes:
**Please Note:** If you booked a Special Occasion Bareboat Charter, there is still a $150 Captain Fee due directly after the trip. The fee is paid directly to the captain by you. Most of our guests, for awesome service, will tip their captain 15%-20% of the total spend (not just the captain's fee). You can pay the captain's fee and tip with Cash, Credit Card, or Venmo*

[View our Current Captain Roster](https://sailsandiego.com/about-us/)

---	
**We genuinely care about your overall experience from start to finish so please continue reading all the information below:**

**BEFORE ARRIVAL:**
WAIVERS:  Please have every guest sign our sailing waiver prior to your arrival. The waivers are all digital so no need to print anything out. Don't stress if you're having too much difficulty with them, as you can always sign when checking in at our office location. And if the occasion is a surprise, just let us know and your guest can sign theirs at check-in.

FOOD / FLOWER DELIVERIES:  If you've opted to have some flowers and/or food delivered, please let us know as soon as you can so staff are aware and can be on hand to receive them.  And please ensure they'll be delivered no later than 1 hour before your departure time!

**CHECK-IN:**
Please check in at our office 20-30 minutes before the departure time. A physical boarding pass will be required to board your assigned sailboat. Your boarding pass will be provided at our Sail San Diego office, located at 2720 Shelter Island Drive, San Diego, California 92106.

You will find us on the corner of the first floor across the street from the Brigantine Restaurant and next to All Aboard.

After receiving your boarding pass, you will be directed to our private marina for boarding. We will open gates 10 minutes prior to the departure time.

**PARKING:**
San Diego hosts 32 million visitors annually, making parking especially limited during summer. We recommend arriving at least 30 minutes early to find parking or using Lyft.

If using Uber, please ensure you enter our address directly. Do not enter "Sail San Diego," as this will direct the driver to our old location from eight years ago, which is about half a mile away.

[CLICK HERE TO VIEW OUR DIRECTIONS PAGE](https://sailsandiego.com/contact/)

**PROHIBITED ITEMS:**
NO SMOKING, HARD ALCOHOL OR RED WINE.

Feel free to bring outside beverages and snacks, but remember you're on a sailboat so hand-held foods are recommended.

We are a federally regulated business and drugs are strictly prohibited (including Marijuana) while underway or at the marina. Vessel will return to the dock and Harbor Police will be called if the Captain sees or smells Marijuana. **NO EXCEPTIONS!**

From your Captains and Crew at Sail San Diego,

Fair Winds and Following Seas
